rows.grounds: amara (immortal) + tva (abstract noun suffix), accusative singular neuter
bhavet (optative of bhū) + devi (vocative goddess), sandhi fused
jayet (optative of ji) + mṛtyum (accusative death), sandhi fused

items.question: What certain outcome follows from attaining immortality in this teaching?
items.inference: Immortality and conquest of death are certain.
uncertainties: Fused sandhi forms are analyzed as combined tokens.
items.plain_english: Immortality would be, O goddess; death is conquered, without doubt.
